description: Get credentials to consume the LIVE stdout/stderr stream of a Node.js application. Returns a one-shot JWT (valid ~1h) and the endpoint URL on `manager-logs-01.hosting-ik.com`. The stream itself is Server-Sent Events: consume with `curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' <endpoint>`. To fetch a single snapshot, kill the curl after a few lines. Manager-private.
name: infomaniak_nodejs_app_logs

consumer_hint.description: Suggested consumer: `curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' <endpoint>` or an EventSource with a custom header.

endpoint.description: URL of the live log stream — Server-Sent Events on manager-logs-01.hosting-ik.com.

expires_at_iso.description: ISO timestamp of JWT expiry, decoded from the token's `exp` claim.

jwt_token.description: Short-lived bearer JWT (~1h) — pass as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when connecting to the endpoint.
